svg.text: Harness frame: around the model, the question kept on its way

What Harness wave 1 built: settings and reports for the user, the rules and the date in the prompt, a loop that ends a refused run, and the conversation kept within the model's context. working tree on 5ca550a, 2026-10-12.
depth (shown with their source, set, reset)
/context: what the next request holds, in tokens

today's date; the user's files first, then the
web; search_notes first, grep to complete;
note what the files cover, then the web
new eval agent per question; repeat not run;
three rounds of refused calls in a row:
told to answer with what it has
the web ones by name; at most 1 MiB, then said
a page (50 KiB, 2,000 lines) or the room left:
results become [R3: read(…) returned …]; then the
oldest turns summarized by the model (kept);
latest round cut; access checked on replay
every result whole, by its ref; recall(ref, from)
in memory when no history is recorded

too long: trimmed to what it counted, resent

below what was sent; taken as its context,
trimmed, resent; a context a server showed
